id: \rWelcome. Have you seen the ruins in town here? They tell the story of Dialga and Palkia.
en: \rWelcome. Have you seen the ruins in town here?  They tell the story of Dialga and Palkia.
it: \rBenvenuto. Hai visto le rovine qui in città? Raccontano la storia di Dialga e Palkia.

id: \bAipom
en: \bAipom
it: \bAipom

id: \bWelcome to the Celestic Town Historical Research Center. Feel free to look around.
en: \bWelcome to the Celestic Town Historical Research Center. Feel free to look around.
it: \bBenvenuto al Centro di Ricerca Storica di Memoride. Sentiti libero di dare un'occhiata.

id: \rChimchar
en: \rChimchar
it: \rChimchar

id: \bYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
en: \bYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
it: \bSembri stanco. Perché non ti riposi un po'?

id: \bOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \bOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \bOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \bFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
en: \bFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
it: \bPrima di tutto, dovresti far recuperare le forze ai tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bSaturn: Oh, you again? Don't think you'll stop us this time.
en: \bSaturn: Oh, you again? Don't think you'll stop us this time.
it: \bSaturno: Oh, ancora tu? Non pensare di fermarci, stavolta.

id: \bSaturn: The Lustrous Orb is secured. Mars, let us retreat.
en: \bSaturn: The Lustrous Orb is secured. Mars, let us retreat.
it: \bSaturno: La Splendisfera è al sicuro. Martes, ritiriamoci.

id: \rThe Celestic Ruins have been here for ages. Few people are allowed to enter.
en: \rThe Celestic Ruins have been here for ages. Few people are allowed to enter.
it: \rLe Rovine di Memoride sono qui da secoli. A pochi è concesso entrare.

id: \bHello.
en: \bHello.
it: \bCiao.

id: \bI can't believe they took the orb. What are we going to do?
en: \bI can't believe they took the orb. What are we going to do?
it: \bNon posso credere che abbiano preso la sfera. Cosa facciamo adesso?

id: \rMars: Haha. You're too late.
en: \rMars: Haha. You're too late.
it: \rMartes: Ahah. Sei arrivato tardi.

id: \bXatu!
en: \bXatu!
it: \bXatu!

id: \bFrom our research we have discover two orbs. Show me Dialga and I will give you one.
en: \bFrom our research we have discover two orbs.  Show me Dialga and I will give you one.
it: \bDalle nostre ricerche abbiamo scoperto due sfere. Mostrami Dialga e te ne darò una.

id: \bOh, you have one. Please take this.
en: \bOh, you have one. Please take this.
it: \bOh, ne hai uno. Prendi questa, ti prego.

id: \bCome back anytime.
en: \bCome back anytime.
it: \bTorna quando vuoi.

id: \bThe Adamant Orb boosts the power of Dialga's STAB attacks.
en: \bThe Adamant Orb boosts the power of Dialga's STAB attacks.
it: \bL'Adamasfera aumenta la potenza degli attacchi STAB di Dialga.

en: \bThe Lustrous Orb boosts the power of Palkia's STAB attacks.
